sections.label: 🚀 Feature
items: Headings inside an Annotation (wiki "== … ==") are now sub-section bars like Credits' "Release": same colour and indent, collapsible on a click, expanded by default. They are no longer treated as page-level sections (h2 colour, page-wide Ctrl+Click, Ctrl+2).
Ctrl+Click on a Credits or Annotation sub-heading toggles every sub-heading of that section, and only that section.

MusicBrainz's native "Show less..." link under an expanded Annotation is removed from the rendered page; the Annotation heading already collapses the section. While the annotation is still clipped (auto-expand off), its "Show more..." link is kept.

sections.label: 🐛 Fix
items: An expanded Annotation that contains a heading now stays in view as a whole when a wide table is scrolled sideways. Before, the text slid away and only "Show less…" and the "last modified" line stayed put: a section body holding an h2 was never pinned, and the heading pinned on its own could not leave it.

sections.label: 🐛 Fix
items: The "Release" / "Release group" sub-headings inside an expanded Credits section are now indented under their h2, the same way the data sub-table headings (e.g. "1 - CD") are under the Tracklist h2. Their style was copied from the sub-table headings without the left margin.
